title: Escape Markdown in titles/tags/correspondents/queries in all replies
description: Legacy-Markdown messages interpolate unescaped paperless strings; a * in a title or lone _ in a tag/correspondent 400s the whole /recent, /inbox or search reply, surfacing as misleading generic errors. Fix: escape (or MarkdownV2 + escape_markdown) everywhere user/paperless strings are interpolated. (handlers.py:759 and messages in _process_upload, duplicate, mark-reviewed)

title: Tag confirm must merge tags, not replace (strips inbox/classifier tags)

title: Enable concurrent update processing (one upload freezes whole bot)
description: No .concurrent_updates() on Application builder and all handlers block; wait_for_task polls up to UPLOAD_TASK_TIMEOUT (300s+) so one upload queues every other message/callback. Fix: Application.builder().concurrent_updates(True) or background the poll via application.create_task. From verified multi-agent review (handlers.py:799).
